# 85. Pokergeniets mardrömmar på aktiemarknaden

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-09-02  
**Market Sentiment**: Neutral

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is an interview episode of Veckans Trade with an anonymous guest. He went from Magic, StarCraft and Counter-Strike to professional poker, then moved into investing alongside Gilmore and David Lindskog. Most of the episode covers his game-theory approach to poker and how hard it was to turn that engineering mindset into his own investment decisions. There is very little stock-specific talk. The main market points are in a sponsor segment: fund manager Martin Lindqvist sold his Bure shares into the rally and increased his holding in the niche bank Enity, which he sees as cheap with forced sellers. The hosts also make general comments that Swedish small caps have been out of favour.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ENITY — Enity | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited fund manager Martin Lindqvist (Prio Nilsson) added to Enity, calling it too cheap with forced sellers in the market.

#### Reasoning

This is cited fund-manager opinion, not the host's own view, and it came up in a sponsor segment. Lindqvist reportedly sold Bure into its rally and moved the money into Enity. His reasons are a cheap valuation and forced, non-fundamental selling pressure, which is a special-situation setup. The host clearly admires the move.

#### Sell Triggers

- if forced selling pressure ends without a rerating
- if Enity's credit quality or earnings deteriorate
- if Lindqvist cuts the position

> *"har istället viktat upp i bolaget den här nischbanken Enity som han lite flaggade för när han intervjuade sig i den här podcasten. Det är lite för billigt och det känns som att det är lite forcerade säljare i marknaden."*

---

### 🟢 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Intro teaser clip says Nordisk has done fantastically and it is 'bara att köpa ännu mer'. The clip is out of context.

#### Reasoning

The only support is a short, out-of-context teaser clip that looks like it comes from a different episode. The speaker is joking, and the same clip includes 'Jag ska lasta ur. Rubbet', which may contradict it. Treat this as speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the clip turns out to be ironic or a sell comment
- if momentum reverses

> *"Det är ju då Nordisk som har gått fantastiskt bra förstås. Men det är bara att köpa ännu mer."*
